_about: The dashboard To-Do feed: a short, layman-readable daily checklist of curation work (for Sam) and engineering/pre-curation work (for Fable, the Claude session), rendered by cpl_todos.js as the 📋 To-Do button on every tab. Refreshed at every Rule-8 checkpoint alongside the session handoff (this file is the handoff distilled for the dashboard). Check-off state lives in each viewer's browser (localStorage) and resets when _as_of changes. Keep it SHORT — ≤ ~12 items; done items are deleted, not checked.
_status: SESSION 58 (Bruh Skyleader): a big Suggested-merges upgrade across THREE shipped PRs, off your Algebra + ESL screenshots. (1) Groups by the OBVIOUS keyword now — Part/Semester/Level divider words fold, so 'Algebra 1-2, Semester 1' / 'Elementary Algebra, Part 1' / 'Algebra 3-4' are ONE family; and a synonym map means 'ESL' and 'English as a Second Language' finally group together (ASL, PE, Math too) — a slider could never do that, since the two share no words. (2) Pick a course in 'Merge into a different course' and its title fills the box so you can CLEAN IT UP before folding. (3) A '➕ Add more courses by keyword' search lets you pull in extras (type 'ESL', check the ones that fit). (4) A 🏷 'match strength' slider in the popup header reveals weaker title matches when you slide it down (default 0.62 = today; slide to 0.50 for more). (5) A 'Completion note' box stamps a merge ('both parts required for full credit') as a ⚑ chip. Every merge is still your one-click Confirm. Hard-refresh to see it all. Next engineering lever (measured first): the member-join Jaccard.

items.text: ✨ Suggested merges got a big upgrade: groups by the obvious keyword (Algebra, the languages, ESL, Ballet, Cosmetology) — divider words AND abbreviations fold (ESL ≡ English as a Second Language). Confirm the obvious families; UNCHECK or Skip a genuine progression (units are the tell). NEW tools in the popup: '➕ Add more courses by keyword' (pull in extras by search), the 🏷 'match strength' slider (slide down to see weaker title matches), title-cleanup when you pick a different target course, and a 'Completion note' box (⚑ chip, e.g. 'both parts required'). If a keyword over-merges, tell Fable and we'll tighten the map/token.

Still queued: the 🏷 title-similarity lane (~5,457 groups). Say the word and Fable DRY-RUNs a high-cosine, cross-college, band-gated pass 2 (reversible, marker automerge-titlelane-v1) for your review before anything applies.

Second-look the earlier auto-merge cohort: CCR → Triage → 'Auto-merged' lists all 2,272 bot-merged courses (⚙ chip inline). Expand a few ⛓ merged rows — anything off, tell Fable; one row or the whole cohort can be reverted.

ARTS M1201's discipline 'Ceramic Technology' is a real MQ name but isn't in the canonical-SUBJ4 map, so the SUBJ4 fold skips it. Your call: add a canonical SUBJ4 for it (a _CANON_SUBJ4:: pick) or re-curate the row to 'Art'.

395 college course titles carry encoding garbage at the source. The dashboard shows them repaired with a '⚠ fix in COCI' chip; the campaign list is kb/coci_title_corrections.json — take it to the colleges when ready.
MilStudents dataset: ping Fable when it's live in the Custom Reports module — that wires the true JSTs-uploaded universe into the Veteran card (aggregates only, no student IDs).

Next consolidation lever (Sam endorsed): lower the member-join title Jaccard 0.5 → ~0.4 so more raw college courses attach per identity. kb/README mandates MEASURING member-row flips FIRST — prototype the title-filtered raw-list join, count attach/detach at 0.4 vs 0.5, sample the 0.3–0.5 band, present before committing. Higher blast radius than the worklist loosening (changes membership + units/disc aggregation), so its own measured PR + dispatch.

On Sam's go: DRY-RUN title-lane pass 2 — the planner already supports it (`python3 kb/_auto_merge_worklist.py --pass2-title`, receipt kb/automerge_out/<date>-titlelane/). Present counts; apply only on sign-off, then re-key Supabase via the supabase-rekey workflow + dispatch.

Finish the Z scheme's future-mint half (deferred S56): point kb/_auto_merge_worklist.py's mint + an excel_to_dashboard.py promote-step at the persisted counter kb/uc_cur_zseq.json so NEW merges get clean Z ids (reuse compute_plan's derive_subj4). Then re-run python3 kb/_row_audit.py + commit latest.json so Z rows get audit chips.

Wire a one-click revert for an individual auto-merged row (whole-cohort revert = delete reviewer_email='automerge-v1@bot'). Consider the ⚙ auto-merged chip on the CSR/CER if they surface merged identities.
